spending_authorization.policy: Spend only for justified accepted progress; ceiling is not a target. Reallocate by need within USD70; user activation required for backup.
spending_authorization.scope: Shared Token Factory development and bounded application validation, not additional paid infrastructure
spending_authorization.accounting: Track failures and maximum in-flight commitments; reconcile prior unknown usage and actual account balance. Provider-side cap is not configured.

tavily_authorization.policy: Cached-first, targeted reviewable discovery; deduplicate queries/URLs; bound credits per refresh and record actual usage. No automatic broad crawls or per-set searches.
tavily_authorization.live_product_route: Remains disabled until T10 operator, timeout and spend controls exist

scope: Remaining personal MVP, four planned exercises through T14; T15 and T17 excluded
task_token_definition: Cumulative billed input plus completion tokens across drafting, review and repairs. Completion includes reasoning; do not double count it.
heavier_task_policy: 100k is an initial allowance, not a hard token limit. Increase only with demonstrated need and a recorded forecast inside the shared USD70 operating ceiling; keep USD30 protected.
request_output_policy: Allocate reasoning plus final output; typically 16384-32768 initially, 49152-65536 for justified heavy requests only if provider supports it. Task allowance is not max_tokens or context size.

runtime_validation_reserve.status: Separate optional allowance for bounded application validation, not approval for automatic live calls

availability: Verify exact model ID, account access, reasoning controls and maximum output before selection. Published prices do not prove deployment quality.

past_usage.note: Historical failed calls excluded from remaining-work forecast. Unknown usage is not zero.

calibration_2026_10_20.reason: Reasoning exhaustion, rejected source and request-control diagnosis; generic helper remains deferred.
calibration_2026_10_20.forecast_decision: Retain the remaining MVP forecast as provisional. Three pose components do not justify a blanket reduction; include failed-call overhead and human integration corrections. Use compact source-specific requests with one writer; no generic framework retry loop.
